title: Runtime Application Compose Provider Binding Proof Manifest
description: Bounded USF-183 runtime proof manifest for API and worker dev runtime execution with an SDK-backed Mailpit composed provider binding, explicit service catalogue traceability, narrowed deferred provider bindings, teardown obligations, evidence boundaries, and explicit non-claims.
aiGuidance: This manifest supports bounded USF-183 runtime provider-binding proof only. It does not claim full dev readiness, full React parity, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, or ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

assertions: API binds to loopback on an ephemeral port
health route reports dev-in-memory runtime mode
readiness route reports service catalogue authority
OpenAPI route exposes tenant-context
tenant mismatch fails closed
authorization failure fails closed
tenant-context request captures audit evidence
apiProof.auditEvidence: tenant-context audit record count is checked in the API runtime proof
apiProof.tenantBoundary: tenant mismatch request returns a closed failure status
apiProof.accessBoundary: authorization failure request returns a closed failure status
apiProof.secretBoundary: runtime uses only synthetic local seed data and no external provider credentials
apiProof.syntheticDataBoundary: runtime proof sends only synthetic tenant, actor, and job data
apiProof.providerBindingEvidence: API proof verifies in-memory notification provider configuration remains explicit and is not silently treated as composed-backed.

assertions: worker run-once proof starts through the worker entry point
worker submits and executes a synthetic tenant maintenance job
worker cross-tenant job read fails closed
worker authorization failure fails closed
worker job lifecycle produces audit evidence
workerProof.auditEvidence: worker proof requires job lifecycle and denial audit events
workerProof.tenantBoundary: cross-tenant worker job read fails closed
workerProof.accessBoundary: unauthorized worker job submission fails closed
workerProof.secretBoundary: worker proof uses no real secrets or external provider credentials
workerProof.syntheticDataBoundary: worker proof submits synthetic tenant, actor, and job payload data only
workerProof.providerBindingEvidence: Worker proof verifies in-memory notification delivery remains hermetic and reports providerMode in-memory.

teardown.childProcesses: API and worker child processes are stopped in finally paths with SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback.
teardown.composeResources: No Compose resources are started for dev-in-memory mode.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Dedicated Mailpit REST API TypeScript client selected for the Mailpit composed service because no official Mailpit Node SDK is present in the repo.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: npm registry metadata inspected on 2026-06-30 reported latest version 2.1.0, Node engine >=18.0.0, MIT license, GitHub repository, and publish/update activity in June 2026.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Zero runtime dependency package; proof output stores only endpoint_ref, hashes, and value-free provider summaries.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Published package includes TypeScript declaration files and ESM/CJS exports compatible with the repo TypeScript moduleResolution posture.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Mailpit API client targets the loopback-bound Mailpit HTTP API in compose.dev.generated.yaml and uses no external network egress or real credentials.
alternativesRejected: Raw HTTP was rejected because provider clients must use an SDK or client boundary when one is suitable.
Nodemailer was rejected for this proof because it is a generic SMTP client and would not provide Mailpit service readback and cleanup through a service-specific client.
mailpit-ws was rejected because real-time WebSocket events are not required for deterministic API and worker provider proof.

syntheticDataBoundary: Runtime proof sends synthetic tenant ids, actor ids, and job payload markers only.
accessBoundary: API and worker proofs verify fail-closed authorization paths and bind API host exposure to loopback.
auditEvidenceBoundary: API proof verifies tenant-context audit evidence; worker proof verifies job lifecycle and denial audit evidence.
secretBoundary: Runtime proof does not use real secrets, production data, or external provider credentials.
tenantBoundary: API tenant mismatch and worker cross-tenant job read fail closed.

deferredBoundaries.boundary: Runtime repository adapter binding remains deferred; DB/RLS proof exists outside API/worker runtime assembly.
API and worker runtime proof does not yet use a composed event-bus adapter.
File/object runtime adapter remains in-memory until composed object-store proof.
Runtime dev claims remain hermetic; Keycloak composed verifier proof is separate from API/worker binding.
Runtime secret resolver remains synthetic local; composed secret manager binding is deferred.
Workflow-provider runtime binding remains profile-gated and requires separate proof.

enterpriseEvidenceSupport.runtimeAssetEvidence: API and worker runtime assets are named by entry point and command; Mailpit provider asset traceability is recorded in the provider binding matrix.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.ownerLinkage: Owner, risk owner, and control owner trace through the service catalogue entries and provider registry entries for platform API, worker, Mailpit, and deferred composed dependencies.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.auditEventProduction: Proof code requires API tenant-context evidence, notification provider configuration evidence, worker job lifecycle evidence, and worker notification delivery evidence.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.healthReadinessEvidence: Proof code requires health, readiness, and OpenAPI route exposure for the API runtime.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.tenantIsolationEvidence: Proof code requires API tenant mismatch and worker cross-tenant job read failures.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.accessControlEvidence: Proof code requires API and worker authorization failures to fail closed.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.secretBoundaryEvidence: Mailpit composed proof uses no real credentials; safe evidence records endpoint_ref only and hashes provider message identifiers.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.syntheticDataEvidence: Proof code uses synthetic tenant, actor, and job payload data only.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.operationalTeardownEvidence: Proof code tears down child processes, Compose resources, and Mailpit synthetic messages through adapter cleanup.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.incidentResponseEvidenceBoundary: No incident response readiness is claimed; future incident workflow evidence remains separate.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.changePromotionEvidenceBoundary: Change and promotion evidence is limited to schema validation, runtime validator output, local proof execution, git history, PR checks, and merge record.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.serviceCatalogueTraceability: Compose-backed proof links to spec/instances/compose-service/service-catalogue.json, compose/compose.dev.generated.yaml, provider registry ids, and Mailpit service id.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.statementOfApplicabilitySupport: Fields support future Statement of Applicability evidence organisation only and do not claim certification.
